how_to_apply: Visit the official OSSSC website at www.osssc.gov.in.
Open the recruitment section and find the Medical Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026 advertisement.
Check the educational qualification, professional registration, Odia-language and age requirements.
Select the New User Registration option if you have not previously registered with OSSSC.
Existing registered candidates must log in and complete the prescribed re-registration process for this recruitment.
Enter the required personal, contact and educational information.
Provide a valid personal email address and mobile number.
Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and other required files.
Complete registration or re-registration by 10 December 2026.
Log in and open the separate online application form for Medical Laboratory Technician 2026.
Enter DMLT/BMLT qualification and professional registration details.
Select the applicable category and reservation claims.
Provide district preferences in the prescribed order.
Pay the applicable Rs. 500 examination fee unless exempt.
Review all application entries and uploaded documents.
Submit the completed online application by 17 December 2026.
Download and retain the application confirmation for future reference.
Important: OSSSC will not issue an admission letter to candidates who register but fail to submit the completed online application. Applicants must successfully complete both stages.
important_instructions: Candidates are required to indicate their preferred districts while completing the online application.
District preferences should be arranged carefully because allocation is based on merit, reservation, vacancy availability and the rules prescribed by the commission.
The commission may allow candidates to revise district preferences through a separate official notice. Once the applicable preference window closes, further changes may not be entertained.
Important: Selection for a particular district is not guaranteed merely because the candidate has listed that district as the first preference.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Medical Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Yes. Candidates who have passed +2 Science and completed a recognized Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology can apply if they meet the registration, age and other eligibility requirements. Yes. Candidates holding a recognized Bachelor in Medical Laboratory Technology qualification can apply, provided they meet the remaining conditions of the notification. Yes. Candidates must have registered their names in the Laboratory Technician Council in the State of Odisha and possess a valid Registration or Renewal Certificate from the competent authority. Candidates must be able to speak, read and write Odia and satisfy at least one of the accepted language conditions: Passed Middle School examination with Odia as a language subject. Passed Matriculation or an equivalent examination with Odia as a medium of examination in a non-language subject. Passed Odia as a language subject in the final examination of Class VII or above from a school or educational institution recognized by the Government of Odisha or Central Government. Passed the Odia language test in Middle English School Standard conducted by the School and Mass Education Department of Odisha.

content_sections.text: Selected Medical Laboratory Technicians will receive pay according to the Odisha Revised Scales of Pay Rules, 2017. Salary Clarification: The advertised range represents the pay matrix. Actual monthly take-home pay depends on applicable allowances, deductions and service conditions.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Medical Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The examination fee is Rs. 500 for candidates other than SC, ST and PwD categories. Payment Mode: Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card or UPI through the online payment gateway. Yes. The notification provides that the Rs. 500 examination fee will be refunded to candidates who appear for the written examination, subject to verification of attendance and applicable conditions. The refund will be credited to the bank account or payment method used during online payment. No refund is admissible to applicants who fail to appear for the examination for any reason.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Medical Laboratory Technician Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a written examination followed by document verification and the applicable merit-based district allocation process. Online registration or re-registration. Submission of the completed online application. Written examination. Preparation of provisional merit list. Screening and verification of original documents. District preference and counselling/allotment, as applicable. Publication of provisional selection list. Final appointment by the appropriate authority. The commission may conduct the written examination in OMR or Computer-Based Recruitment Examination (CBRE) mode. The exact examination mode, date and venue will be notified separately.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Medical Laboratory Technician Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination will contain 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks , with a duration of two hours. There will be negative marking in the written examination. Each correct answer carries one mark. For each incorrect answer, 0.25 mark will be deducted. Marking multiple options for one question will be treated as a wrong answer. No penalty will be imposed for unanswered questions. Important: Obtaining the minimum qualifying marks does not guarantee selection. Candidates must secure a sufficient position in the merit list according to the vacancies, reservation and selection rules.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for OSSSC Laboratory Technician Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents ready, as applicable to their eligibility and reservation claims: HSC or equivalent certificate for date-of-birth proof. +2 Science certificate and marksheet. DMLT or BMLT qualification certificate and marksheets. Valid Laboratory Technician Council registration or renewal certificate. Odia-language qualification certificate, where applicable. SC/ST/SEBC certificate, where applicable. PwD certificate or UDID card, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen documents, where applicable. Sportsperson certificate, where applicable. Relevant contractual employment or COVID-19 healthcare service documents, where applicable. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature and other prescribed uploads. Valid mobile number and personal email address. Examination fee payment details, where applicable. Original certificates must be produced during document verification. Candidates should check the exact upload formats and document specifications on the official application portal.

Important: Selection for a particular district is not guaranteed merely because the candidate has listed that district as the first preference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) for filling up medical laboratory technician vacancies across various districts in the state of Odisha for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 380 vacancies have been officially announced for the post of Medical Laboratory Technician under advertisement number IIE-99/2026-3440/OSSSC for the year 2026 recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the +2 Science Examination and hold a Diploma in Medical Technology (DMLT) or Bachelor in Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT) along with valid registration in the state council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must have attained a minimum age of 21 years and must not be above the age of 42 years as on the date of advertisement, with permissible relaxations for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for the Medical Laboratory Technician post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary as per Pay Scale 25500-81100 in Pay Matrix Level-7, Cell-01 as specified in the official notification released by the Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission.

faq.question: Q6. What are the starting and ending dates to apply online?
faq.answer: The online application submission starts on 17 November 2026 and the last date to submit the completed online application form along with fee payment is 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, an application fee of Rs. 500/- is applicable for candidates other than Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), and Persons with Disabilities (PwD) who are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for this job?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Test consisting of objective-type multiple-choice questions followed by document verification of shortlisted candidates as per the criteria mentioned.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I submit my application form?
faq.answer: Candidates can submit their applications exclusively through online mode by visiting the official OSSSC website at www.osssc.gov.in and completing the registration and application processes.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required during the application process?
faq.answer: Applicants require educational certificates, DMLT/BMLT certificates, Odisha Laboratory Technician Council registration certificate, caste certificate if applicable, and identity proof documents ready while applying.
